name: Concatenate raws
summary: Concatenate multiple MNE.Raw instances into single .Raw
description: Joins several MNE raw files end to end with mne.concatenate_raws(), for example multiple runs or sessions, and writes one raw.fif with a QC report. Inputs must share the same channels and bad channels (order is normalised automatically). It reads no configuration parameters.

inputs.description: Continuous MNE raw files to concatenate.
inputs.requirements: All files must share the same set of channels and the same bad channels.
